title: Suspended High-Schooler Returns To School Then Refuses To Leave Campus
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On May 27th, 2023. Officers were called to a high school regarding a teenager who was involved in a previous incident which led to her suspension. The student then returned on campus to write a test however, the cops were called to remove her from campus because she didn’t want to leave. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
